svg.text: • Single-page UI, served by the web app
• TLS in transit, encryption at rest
• CI/CD with OIDC, no stored keys
One container image runs the web app, the queue worker, the scheduler and the migrate job (Azure Container Apps).
All user and integration traffic enters through the HTTPS ingress only. Database, Key Vault, storage and registry are reachable solely from the application containers through a managed identity.
Collectors keep working offline on tablets; data syncs to the backend when a connection is available. The legacy sdq-12 app uses the same ingress through the legacy API until it is retired.
